scene: Inside a firelit Viking hall in the morning, Ulf, huge and expressive in the foreground (very big young man, cream round face, short black hair, thick black beard, dark red knee-length tunic, grey bearskin cloak slipping off one shoulder, black mitten hands), lies slumped on a bench by the door, too exhausted to lift a wooden cup that trembles in his hand, with a split lip and a round wooden shield with a chewed rim beside him, while behind him every other man in the hall has dragged his bench to the far side and stares at him nervously, and a slim young poet with long light-brown hair counts syllables on his fingers, already composing a poem about it. Visible hardship: the legendary fury, and the morning after.

In the bow of a Viking longship on a grey stormy sea, Ulf, huge and expressive in the foreground (short black hair plastered by spray, thick black beard, dark red tunic, soaked grey bearskin cloak dripping, black mitten hands gripping the wooden stem post), takes a huge wave full in the face with a look of miserable disbelief, while behind him the rowers sit dry and comfortable under their cloaks, one of them grinning and giving a thumbs-up. Visible hardship: the place of honour is also the wettest seat on the ship.
